pokedexLookup.summary: Look up a species in the Pokédex · {{caught}} caught / {{seen}} seen

header.hint1: Caught at any point in this save according to the Pokédex. Seeing a species doesn't complete the checklist; evolving or releasing it doesn't erase its capture.

captureChecklist.zoneSaveFailed: The zone changed, but couldn't be saved for next session.
captureChecklist.noZoneMatches: No matches. The current zone is kept; change or clear the search.
captureChecklist.zoneOrderHint: Suggested first-visit order in Pokémon Black. Optional detours are grouped separately; you can go back to earlier zones.

equipment.hint: Mark your resources manually; they're remembered in this browser. Surf requires a Pokémon that can use it. The filter affects encounter methods, it doesn't check obstacles or progress to reach the zone.
equipment.hiddenCount: Hidden: {{count}} species with no enabled methods.
equipment.filterSaveFailed: The filter works, but couldn't be saved for next session.

errors.loadZones: Couldn't load the zone list from PokéAPI.

captureChecklist.noEncountersRegistered: PokéAPI has no registered encounters for Pokémon Black in this zone.
captureChecklist.footerHint: Includes PokéAPI's encounters for Black and the five trades with in-game characters. It's not a list of every species obtainable by evolution, events, or trading with other players. Percentages correspond to each table/condition; they don't apply to trades with characters.

catalog.heading: Find your Pokémon
catalog.hintReadOnly: Green: Pokémon in your team/boxes or ever caught according to the Pokédex, even if you've evolved or released them. Switch to Manual to manage your manual collection.
catalog.hintManual: Green: Pokémon in your manual collection. Add the ones available in your save. One entry per species.
catalog.hint2ReadOnly: Images reveal once you see or catch a species according to your Pokédex. Hover, tap or focus the icons to check its ways to obtain it in Black. There may be several routes; ❔ marks unconfirmed information.
catalog.hint2Manual: Images reveal once you see or catch a species by adding it to your manual collection. Hover, tap or focus the icons to check its ways to obtain it in Black. There may be several routes; ❔ marks unconfirmed information.
catalog.loadError: Couldn't load the catalog. Check your connection.
catalog.noMatches: No matches. Try another name or the all-generations catalog.

saveCollection.hintLive: Pokémon in the team and boxes. Duplicates are shown separately. Boxes refresh every 2 minutes or when you press Refresh collection. PC changes can take a while to appear; the read can take several seconds. This view is read-only.
saveCollection.hintSave: Pokémon in the team and boxes. Duplicates are shown separately. It updates when you save in the game. This view is read-only.

refresh.connectHint: Connect the live reader to refresh.

saveCollection.emptyCollection: No Pokémon in the team or boxes.
saveCollection.noMatches: No matches with the current filters.

enemyPrototype.heading: Pokémon in battle

messages.disconnected: Battle reading disconnected. Press Reconnect battle.

detail.ownIdentified: Your Pokémon is identified by the specimen on the field.
detail.waitingMatch: Waiting for a matching reading of your active Pokémon.
detail.outOfBattle: Out of battle or no matching reading. The previous rival isn't shown.
detail.activeReadFailed: Couldn't confirm a valid reading of your active Pokémon.

enemyPrototype.noActiveReading: No valid reading yet of the Pokémon on the field.

hints.overview: Your active Pokémon, the rival, and your team's health in single battles. Experimental melonDS reading.
hints.multiplier: Each multiplier corresponds to an attack of that type against the defender's types. Doesn't include STAB, moves, abilities, or items.
hints.weaknesses: Weaknesses show every type that deals super-effective damage to that Pokémon in Generation V, even if the opponent doesn't have that type.
hints.strengths: Strengths show resistances (0.5× or 0.25×) and immunities (0×) by type. Stat changes are kept during transient readings and update once a new reading is confirmed.

connectionIndicator.manualHint: Your team and collection are saved in this browser. Select melonDS to connect a reader.

evolutionDialog.heading: Evolution tree
evolutionDialog.loadError: Couldn't load the evolution. Check your connection to PokéAPI.
evolutionDialog.readingHint: Read the tree from left to right. Each relation shows how it evolves into the next species in Black/White. Alternative branches are shown one below the other.
evolutionDialog.scrollAria: Evolution family; scroll horizontally to see every stage
evolutionDialog.noEvolutionsHint: This species has no evolutions or pre-evolutions in Generation V.

encounterChances.label: Appearance
encounterChances.seasonalTitle: These encounters depend on the season. Check the season shown next to each percentage.
encounterChances.valuesTitle: By method and conditions: {{summary}}. See details in {{detailsLabel}}.

analysis.onlyTypesHint: Types only: doesn't include abilities, items, or move effects.
analysis.emptyHint: Add your first member to see the team analysis.

insight.noneSuperEffective: No attacking type is super-effective against two or more members.

analysis.multiplierLegend: Weak: 2× / 4× · Neutral: 1× · Resists: ½× / ¼× · Immune: 0×
analysis.tableCaption: Defensive effectiveness and multipliers for each member
analysis.coverageHint: Individual rival types you can hit super-effectively with your own types. Doesn't guarantee you know a move of that type.

typeChart.hint: Rows: attacking type. Columns: defending type. Each cell shows damage against a single type. In Pokémon Black, Steel resists Ghost and Dark.
typeChart.tableCaption: Damage multipliers in Generation V: attacking rows and defending columns

acquisitionIcons.retryError: Couldn't check how to obtain it. Retry
acquisitionIcons.groupAria: Ways to obtain it in Pokémon Black

label.capture: Catchable in Pokémon Black. Check the zones and encounter conditions.
label.static: Fixed encounter in Pokémon Black; may require progress or special conditions.
label.gift: Gift in Pokémon Black; may depend on a choice or special conditions.
label.fossil: Revive a fossil at the museum in Nacrene City. Your choice and progress may limit its availability.
label.npc-trade: Trade with a character in Pokémon Black; requires the requested Pokémon.
label.evolution: Generation V evolution. You need its pre-evolution; check the tree for the requirements.
label.trade-evolution: Trade evolution. May require holding an item or trading for a specific species.
label.breed: Breeding: get an egg from compatible parents. Some species require Incense; you need to obtain the parents.
label.external: No direct way to obtain it in the normal Black game: bring the species or its family from another game via trade or transfer.
label.event: Event or special distribution; not guaranteed to still be available. Can also be received from another player.
label.unknown: Unconfirmed way to obtain it: no direct route is on record. This doesn't prove it's only obtainable by evolving or trading.

saveSync.saveHint: Set up <configFile>save.config.local.json</configFile> and run <bridgeCommand>npm run bridge</bridgeCommand>. It syncs when the game saves to the .sav file. The manual team is kept.
